top_choice_rationale: P002 is a quantitative prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic angle) followed by an experimental surprise (correlated insulators and superconductivity), with the phases reproduced by many independent groups using transport, scanning probes and spectroscopy, and a general moire platform since. A citation limited to the flat bands and the observed phases, silent on pairing mechanism, rests only on what is verified. Maturity (eight years) and credit (Cao, Lopes dos Santos, early experimental groups) are real weaknesses, so P001 is a close and fully defensible second: the better-settled and cleanly attributed discovery, with independently reproduced 1e-18 performance. P003 follows because sources are still at 3-4 sigma and pioneer credit is unresolved, and I defer on astroparticle physics. No award is last, since two mature, reproduced achievements are available.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my electronic-structure and magnetism work is adjacent to moire quantum materials, which could bias me toward P002, and I have no known tie to MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero, Bistritzer, Katori, Ye, Halzen or Spiering
